evidence:
Floor cases that ARE handled: (a) blank / no-op: /app starts with only .gitkeep (environment/Dockerfile), test.sh:68-70 exits with the pre-written zero reward when /app/server.js is absent, and :115-125 when nothing answers HTTP. (b) Pure static page: render gate (gates/render/judge.toml) requires wrong-password rejection plus Gwen's matters, and both gates name 'static mock'/'missing backend' as failures; every functional criterion requires browser writes or replays of recorded server requests. (c) Keyword stuffing: all judges are browser-behaviour only (prompts: 'Use only rendered browser behavior', untrusted-evidence clause), so text stuffing earns nothing. (d) Refuse-everything: functional prompt.md 'Every refusal pairs with a success of the same kind on an eligible target' and constraints prompt 'A negative check requires its stated positive control'; every refusal criterion carries a success control. CDN/off-origin is correctly not treated as a floor case (gate texts allow it).

Gap: a seed-copy read-only facade is not floored. scoring.toml [floors] functional = 0.05 with score.py:47 'scores[k] > f'. Functional criterion weights sum to 34.0 (2+2+2+1.5+2+3+2+1.5+2+1.5+2+1.5+2+2.5+2+3+1.5), so any single criterion of weight >=2.0 (2/34=0.059) clears the floor. Neither gate exercises a write: constraints gate only 'Sign in as gwen..., note her matter list, then reload' and explicitly 'does not grade ... persistence'; render gate only signs in. REVIEW_POLICY.md: 'Health reachability and a static JSON response do not prove server-backed persistence. Use an actual successful operation and independent-context readback'. Two functional criteria are fully satisfiable on untouched seed data with no write at all: deleted_and_expired_seed_messages (weight 3.0 = 0.088 of functional; Part A/B only read the seeded M-11 thread, search and transcript, positive controls 'Clause 14 noted' and 'Rent review meeting moved...' are seed rows, kittle.json lines 49/76/83/98) and wall_every_route (weight 2.0; Sian/Dev reads, searches, and replays of recorded GET requests). Polish criteria timer_label, hold_mark, phone_matter, transcript_print need only seed display, and refusal_in_place is satisfied by wrong-password vs correct sign-in; visual is presentation-only by design ('Never grade product behaviour...'). The only defence is the undefined phrase 'seeded-looking facade' in the global browser gate, whose stated steps (load, sign in as Gwen, see protected content) a server returning hardcoded per-user seed JSON satisfies; the judge has no write step to detect it, and an honest app whose writes failed would look equally 'seeded'. No weak-app or reward-discrimination run exists (raw-evidence-index scope: 'reward discrimination/ranking ... absent'), so this is reasoned, not measured.
counterexample: server.js (~150 lines, Express) that: checks the five seed passwords and sets a session cookie; serves GET endpoints returning hardcoded, pre-filtered slices of /assets/kittle.json per user (M-12 omitted for Dev and Gwen, the 1-May and exactly-7-day M-11 rows omitted, a 'original message deleted' placeholder baked in); a substring search over that static array; a static transcript page; a pretty CSS layout with matter sidebar, timer label and On hold badges; a message box and buttons that do nothing (POST returns 404). Expected: both gates pass (sign-in works, wrong password refused, reload keeps list, data comes from the local server); functional = deleted_and_expired_seed_messages 3.0 + wall_every_route 2.0 = 5/34 = 0.147 > 0.05 floor; polish ~4-5/5 (timer_label, hold_mark, phone_matter, transcript_print, refusal_in_place via sign-in); visual ~3-4/5. Reward ~= 0.6*0.147 + 0.2*0.8..1.0 + 0.2*0.6..0.8 ~= 0.30-0.45 for a chat app that cannot send a single message. Even with only the 3.0 seed criterion, functional 0.088 clears the floor and unlocks ~0.3 of polish+visual mass.
suggested_fix: Without touching the template floor or score.py: make the constraints gate (task-specific criterion text) require a real server-backed write with independent-context readback (e.g. Gwen posts 'Gate check JUDGE-G0' in M-11; in a fresh browser context Harriet signs in and sees it; reload keeps it), and add a write-based positive control to the two seed-only functional criteria (e.g. deleted_and_expired_seed_messages also checks a message posted in an earlier criterion is shown/searchable in M-11; wall_every_route also requires a Sian post visible to Sian but not Dev), then measure a read-only seed facade through the full configured verifier to confirm reward ~0.
